source: Phase 41 (2026-10-18): original questions on the chapters of Beast Academy Levels 1-5 and the AoPS books, written by Claude Sonnet from our own chapter summaries (docs/question-bank-beast-academy.md) and solved blind by Claude Opus (Claude Code agents, not runAi: no ai_runs rows), code-checked by lintQuestion; "checked" questions await a platform admin.

notes.ALG.01: Five skills, about 20 each (order of operations split into whole-number and exponent/negative/grouping parts). Order-of-operations and evaluate questions use numeric answers; expression answers are choice questions.
notes.ALG.02: Eleven skills x 9 questions (3 per difficulty). Expression keys are computed by script (polynomial arithmetic) and every distractor is checked to differ from the key. No fractions or decimals in answers; one negative answer (-4) and some negative inputs, which the chapter uses.
notes.ALG.03: Eleven skills x 9 questions (3 per difficulty). Every equation was verified by script (both sides equal at the key). A few answers are fractions (3/2) or negative (-1, -5, -7); the numeric ones with decimals as options use the decimals the chapter allows (12.5, 4.5). Wording of the "no solution" questions avoids pointing at option positions.
notes.ALG.04: Skills split by name so no skill exceeds about a fifth: solving a formula is shown in three bands (one step, two steps, harder forms).
notes.ALG.05: Word problems are split by context (numbers and ages, money and mixtures, motion and rates) so no skill name dominates. Answers are numbers or choices; decimals only appear in the interest question as given rates.
notes.ALG.08: Generated by scripts/build-b3-ALG.08.mjs. 8 skills; points are always written as coordinates and lines by equations, so no figure is needed. Some numeric questions ask for a fraction in lowest terms.
notes.ALG.09: Generated by scripts/build-b3-ALG.09.mjs. 8 skills, about 12 questions each (15 for word problems). Answers that are counts, extreme integers or fractions are numeric; interval, compound and absolute-value solutions are choice questions.
notes.ALG.10: Built from a generator (scripts/build-b3-ALG.10.mjs); factored-form options are verified by polynomial expansion. 11 skills x 9 questions. The sum/product-of-roots questions include non-monic equations (divide through by the leading coefficient) and one (x+1)(x+2)=(2x-1)(x-3) whose solutions are irrational: only their sum is asked, as the chapter intends. A few word problems use the Pythagorean theorem or areas.
notes.ALG.11: Built from a generator (scripts/build-b3-ALG.11.mjs); factored-form options are verified by polynomial expansion. 11 skills x 9 questions. Difficulty-3 items stretch slightly: x^3+x^2-9x-9=0 and x^4-5x^2+4 are factored by grouping and repeated difference of squares; x+1/x and x^3-style identities with given sums use only the chapter identities. Some answers are negative or fractional, which suits algebra.
notes.ALG.12: Built from scripts/build-b3-ALG.12.mjs, with complex arithmetic done by exact rational code. 11 skills x 9 (3 per difficulty). Complex-valued answers are choice questions; numeric ones ask for a real or imaginary part, a real value, or a real unknown. Square roots of negatives use the principal value sqrt(-n)=i*sqrt(n).
notes.ALG.13: Built from scripts/build-b3-ALG.13.mjs. 11 skills x 9 (3 per difficulty). Irrational solutions and expression answers are choice questions; numeric items have rational answers. Only the last question uses non-real solutions (the chapter's complex numbers come from the previous chapter).
notes.ALG.16: Built with scripts/build-b3-ALG.16.mjs. 11 skills x 9 questions (3 per difficulty each). Function questions use equations, ordered pairs and written-out values only. Some answers are negative or fractional, which suits Introduction to Algebra.
notes.ALG.17: Built with scripts/build-b3-ALG.17.mjs. 11 skills x 9 questions (3 per difficulty each). Graphs are described only by equations, ordered pairs and written-out points, never a picture. Several questions use the y=x^2 and y=|x| families because those are the graphs the chapter transforms.

questions.skill: Order of operations with whole numbers
questions.stem: What is the value of $3+4\times5$?
questions.solution: Multiply before adding: $4\times5=20$, then $3+20=23$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with whole numbers
questions.stem: What is the value of $20-12\div4$?
questions.solution: Divide before subtracting: $12\div4=3$, then $20-3=17$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with whole numbers
questions.stem: Find the value of $2\times3+4\times5$.
questions.solution: Do both multiplications first: $6+20=26$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with whole numbers
questions.stem: What is the value of $18\div3\times2$?
questions.solution: Multiplication and division are done from left to right: $18\div3=6$, then $6\times2=12$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with whole numbers
questions.stem: What is the value of $(7+5)\times2$?
questions.solution: Work inside the parentheses first: $7+5=12$, then $12\times2=24$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with whole numbers
questions.stem: What is the value of $100-5\times10$?
questions.solution: Multiply first: $5\times10=50$. Then $100-50=50$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with whole numbers
questions.stem: What is the value of $9+6\div3$?
questions.solution: Divide first: $6\div3=2$. Then $9+2=11$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with exponents, negatives and grouping
questions.stem: Calculate $2^3+1$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with exponents, negatives and grouping
questions.stem: What is the value of $-3+5\times2$?
questions.solution: Multiply first: $5\times2=10$. Then $-3+10=7$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with exponents, negatives and grouping
questions.stem: A student works out $3^2\times2$. What is the correct answer?
questions.solution: Exponents come before multiplying: $3^2=9$, then $9\times2=18$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with exponents, negatives and grouping
questions.stem: What is the value of $10-2^2$?
questions.solution: Exponent first: $2^2=4$. Then $10-4=6$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with exponents, negatives and grouping
questions.stem: Calculate $5-(-3)$.
questions.solution: Subtracting a negative number is the same as adding: $5+3=8$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with exponents, negatives and grouping
questions.stem: What does $(2+3)^2$ equal?
questions.solution: Parentheses first: $2+3=5$. Then $5^2=25$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with exponents, negatives and grouping
questions.stem: What is the value of $4+3\times(8-6)$?
questions.solution: Parentheses first: $8-6=2$. Then $3\times2=6$, and $4+6=10$.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for given values
questions.stem: Find the value of $3x+2$ when $x=4$.
questions.solution: Replace $x$ with 4: $3\times4+2=12+2=14$.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for given values
questions.stem: If $y=5$, what is the value of $y^2-3$?

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for given values
questions.stem: What is the value of $10-2a$ when $a=3$?
questions.solution: Replace $a$ with 3: $10-2\times3=10-6=4$.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for given values
questions.stem: Find the value of $2m+3n$ when $m=5$ and $n=2$.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for given values
questions.stem: When $n=6$, what is the value of $\frac{n}{2}+n$?
questions.solution: Replace $n$ with 6: $\frac{6}{2}+6=3+6=9$.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for given values
questions.stem: A taxi ride costs $3+2m$ dollars for a trip of $m$ miles. How many dollars does a 7-mile trip cost?
questions.solution: Replace $m$ with 7: $3+2\times7=3+14=17$ dollars.

questions.skill: Use the distributive property
questions.stem: Write 23 as $20+3$ and use the distributive property to find $6\times23$.

questions.skill: Use the distributive property
questions.stem: Which expression is equal to $2(x+5)$?
questions.solution: Multiply both terms inside by 2: $2\times x+2\times5=2x+10$.

questions.skill: Use the distributive property
questions.stem: $3(x+4)=3x+k$. What number is $k$?

questions.skill: Use the distributive property
questions.stem: What is the value of $7\times102$?

questions.skill: Use the distributive property
questions.stem: Find $4\times99$ by writing 99 as $100-1$.

questions.skill: Use the distributive property
questions.stem: Which expression is equal to $3(2a-1)$?
questions.solution: Multiply both terms by 3: $3\times2a-3\times1=6a-3$.

questions.skill: Simplify by combining like terms
questions.stem: Simplify $3x+4x$.
questions.solution: Add the numbers in front of $x$: $3+4=7$, so $3x+4x=7x$.

questions.skill: Simplify by combining like terms
questions.stem: $5a+2a-3a=ka$. What number is $k$?

questions.skill: Simplify by combining like terms
questions.stem: Simplify $2x+5+3x+1$.
questions.solution: Combine the $x$ terms: $2x+3x=5x$. Combine the numbers: $5+1=6$. The result is $5x+6$.

questions.skill: Simplify by combining like terms
questions.stem: $4x+7-x-2$ is simplified to $ax+b$. What is $a+b$?
questions.solution: The $x$ terms: $4x-x=3x$. The numbers: $7-2=5$. So $a=3$, $b=5$, and $a+b=8$.

questions.skill: Simplify by combining like terms
questions.stem: Which two terms are like terms?
questions.solution: Like terms have exactly the same variable part. $6y$ and $-y$ both have $y$. The others have no variable, $y^2$, or the variable $x$.

solve.work: Like terms share the same variable part: 6y and -y.

questions.skill: Simplify by combining like terms
questions.stem: A box holds $x$ pens. Maya has 3 boxes and 5 loose pens. Lee has 2 boxes and 4 loose pens. Together they have $ax+b$ pens. What is $a+b$?
questions.solution: Boxes: $3x+2x=5x$. Loose pens: $5+4=9$. So they have $5x+9$ pens, and $a+b=5+9=14$.

questions.skill: Simplify by combining like terms
questions.stem: Which expression is equal to $x+x+x$?
questions.solution: Adding $x$ three times gives $3\times x=3x$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with whole numbers
questions.stem: Find the value of $48\div6\times2+5$.
questions.solution: Go left to right for division and multiplication: $48\div6=8$, $8\times2=16$. Then add: $16+5=21$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with whole numbers
questions.stem: What is the value of $7+3\times(10-4)$?
questions.solution: Parentheses first: $10-4=6$. Then multiply: $3\times6=18$. Then add: $7+18=25$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with whole numbers
questions.stem: Find the value of $12+18\div3-2\times4$.
questions.solution: Do the division and multiplication first: $18\div3=6$ and $2\times4=8$. Then $12+6-8=10$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with whole numbers
questions.stem: Which expression has the greatest value?
questions.solution: The values are $(2+3)\times4=20$, $2+3\times4=14$, $2\times3+4=10$ and $2\times(3+4)=14$. The greatest is 20.

questions.skill: Order of operations with whole numbers
questions.stem: What is the value of $5\times6-24\div4\times3$?
questions.solution: Multiplying and dividing from the left: $5\times6=30$, and $24\div4=6$, $6\times3=18$. Then $30-18=12$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with whole numbers
questions.stem: What is the value of $64\div8\div2$?
questions.solution: Divide from left to right: $64\div8=8$, then $8\div2=4$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with whole numbers
questions.stem: Find the value of $9+8\div2\times3-5$.
questions.solution: Left to right for division and multiplication: $8\div2=4$, $4\times3=12$. Then $9+12-5=16$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with exponents, negatives and grouping
questions.stem: Evaluate $(-2)^3+10$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with exponents, negatives and grouping
questions.stem: What is the value of $-3^2$?
questions.solution: The exponent applies to the 3 only, and then the minus sign is applied: $-3^2=-(3\times3)=-9$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with exponents, negatives and grouping
questions.stem: Find the value of $2\times3^2-4\times2$.
questions.solution: Exponent first: $3^2=9$. Then $2\times9=18$ and $4\times2=8$. So $18-8=10$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with exponents, negatives and grouping
questions.stem: What is the value of $(12-4\times2)^2+1$?
questions.solution: Inside the parentheses, multiply first: $4\times2=8$, so $12-8=4$. Then $4^2=16$ and $16+1=17$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with exponents, negatives and grouping
questions.stem: Find the value of $\frac{6+2\times3}{2^2}$.
questions.solution: Top: $6+2\times3=12$. Bottom: $2^2=4$. Then $12\div4=3$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with exponents, negatives and grouping
questions.stem: Which number is equal to $4-2\times(-3)$?
questions.solution: Multiply first: $2\times(-3)=-6$. Then $4-(-6)=4+6=10$.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for given values
questions.stem: Find the value of $a^2-2a+1$ when $a=5$.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for given values
questions.stem: If $x=-2$, what is the value of $3x^2-x$?

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for given values
questions.stem: Find the value of $\frac{a+b}{c}$ when $a=11$, $b=7$ and $c=3$.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for given values
questions.stem: Find the value of $4(x+3)-x$ when $x=2$.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for given values
questions.stem: The perimeter of a rectangle with length $l$ and width $w$ is $2l+2w$. What is the perimeter, in centimeters, when $l=9$ and $w=4$?

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for given values
questions.stem: If $p=3$ and $q=-4$, what is the value of $p^2-q^2$?

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for given values
questions.stem: For which value of $x$ does $2x+1$ equal 15?
questions.solution: Try 7: $2\times7+1=15$. The other values give 29, 33 and 17.

questions.skill: Use the distributive property
questions.stem: Find the value of $12\times37+12\times63$.
questions.solution: Both products have the factor 12: $12\times(37+63)=12\times100=1200$.

questions.skill: Use the distributive property
questions.stem: Which expression is equal to $-2(x-4)$?

questions.skill: Use the distributive property
questions.stem: A rectangle is 6 units tall and $x+4$ units wide. Its area, $6(x+4)$, can be written as $6x+k$. What number is $k$?

questions.skill: Use the distributive property
questions.stem: Which expression is equal to $4x+12$?
questions.solution: Both terms have the factor 4: $4x+12=4(x+3)$. Multiplying back gives $4x+12$. The others give $4x+48$, $16x$ and $12x$.

questions.skill: Use the distributive property
questions.stem: $7x-14=7(x-k)$. What number is $k$?

questions.skill: Use the distributive property
questions.stem: Which expression is equal to $x(x+3)$?
questions.solution: Multiply $x$ by each term: $x\times x=x^2$ and $x\times3=3x$. So $x(x+3)=x^2+3x$.

questions.skill: Use the distributive property
questions.stem: Find the value of $99\times37-98\times37$.
questions.solution: Both products have the factor 37: $(99-98)\times37=1\times37=37$.

questions.skill: Simplify by combining like terms
questions.stem: $7x-3y+2x+8y$ is simplified to $ax+by$. What is $a+b$?

questions.skill: Simplify by combining like terms
questions.stem: Simplify $3a^2+2a-a^2+5a$.
questions.solution: The $a^2$ terms: $3a^2-a^2=2a^2$. The $a$ terms: $2a+5a=7a$. The result is $2a^2+7a$.

questions.skill: Simplify by combining like terms
questions.stem: $5-2(x-3)+x$ is simplified to $ax+b$. What is $a+b$?
questions.solution: $-2(x-3)=-2x+6$. So the expression is $5-2x+6+x=-x+11$. Then $a=-1$, $b=11$, and $a+b=10$.

questions.skill: Simplify by combining like terms
questions.stem: Which expression is equal to $10x-(3x-4)$?
questions.solution: The minus sign changes both signs inside: $10x-3x+4=7x+4$.

questions.skill: Simplify by combining like terms
questions.stem: A rectangle has a width of $3x+2$ and a length of $x+5$ (both in centimeters). Its perimeter is $ax+b$. What is $a+b$?
questions.solution: Perimeter $=2\times(\text{width}+\text{length})=2\times(4x+7)=8x+14$. So $a=8$, $b=14$ and $a+b=22$.

questions.skill: Simplify by combining like terms
questions.stem: Simplify $\frac{6x+9}{3}$.
questions.solution: Divide each term on top by 3: $\frac{6x}{3}=2x$ and $\frac{9}{3}=3$. The result is $2x+3$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with whole numbers
questions.stem: Parentheses can be added to $2+3\times4+5$ to change its value. Which way of adding them makes the value 25?
questions.solution: $(2+3)\times4+5=5\times4+5=25$. The others give $2+3\times9=29$, $5\times9=45$ and $2+12+5=19$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with whole numbers
questions.stem: Find the value of $\frac{3+9}{2+4}+2\times3$.
questions.solution: A fraction bar groups the top and the bottom: $\frac{12}{6}=2$. Then $2+2\times3=2+6=8$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with whole numbers
questions.stem: Find the value of $1000-2\times(30+4\times(5+1))$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with whole numbers
questions.stem: In $5\ ?\ 4\ ?\ 3$, one ? is replaced by $+$ and the other ? by $\times$, in either order. What is the largest value you can get?
questions.solution: There are two ways: $5+4\times3=5+12=17$ and $5\times4+3=20+3=23$. The largest is 23.

questions.skill: Order of operations with whole numbers
questions.stem: Find the value of $100\div5\div2\times3-4\times(7-5)$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with whole numbers
questions.stem: What is the value of $2+2\times2+2\times2+2$?
questions.solution: Multiply first: $2\times2=4$ twice. Then $2+4+4+2=12$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with exponents, negatives and grouping
questions.stem: Work out the value of $3^2-2\times(1-4)^2\div3+(-5)$.
questions.solution: Parentheses first: $1-4=-3$, and $(-3)^2=9$. So $2\times9\div3=6$. Also $3^2=9$. Then $9-6+(-5)=-2$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with exponents, negatives and grouping
questions.stem: Which expression has the least value?

questions.skill: Order of operations with exponents, negatives and grouping
questions.stem: Simplify $2^{1+2}\times3^{2-1}$ to a single whole number.
questions.solution: Work the exponents first: $1+2=3$ and $2-1=1$. Then $2^3\times3^1=8\times3=24$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with exponents, negatives and grouping
questions.stem: Evaluate $10-2\times\left(3^2-(4-1)^2\right)+5$.

questions.skill: Order of operations with exponents, negatives and grouping
questions.stem: What number can replace the ? to make $3\times?-2^3=19$ true?

questions.skill: Order of operations with exponents, negatives and grouping
questions.stem: A positive number is called ?. It makes $(?-3)^2+1=26$ true. Which number is it?
questions.solution: Subtract 1: $(?-3)^2=25$. So $?-3$ is 5 or $-5$. Then ? is 8 or $-2$. The positive one is 8.

solve.issues: Wording 'A positive number is called ?.' is awkward (calling it x would read better), but the question is unambiguous.

questions.stem: To change a temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit, use $\frac{9}{5}C+32$. What is the temperature in Fahrenheit when $C=-10$?

questions.stem: Find the value of $4x^2+2x$ when $x=\frac{1}{2}$.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for given values
questions.stem: If $3x-5=22$, what is the value of $6x-10$?
questions.solution: Notice that $6x-10$ is twice $3x-5$. So its value is $2\times22=44$.

questions.skill: Use the distributive property
questions.stem: Find the value of $\frac{8\times13+8\times7}{4}$.
questions.solution: Take out the common factor 8: $8\times(13+7)=8\times20=160$. Then $160\div4=40$.

questions.skill: Use the distributive property
questions.stem: What is the value of $101\times99$?

questions.skill: Use the distributive property
questions.stem: Which expression is equal to $3(x+2)-2(x-5)$?
questions.solution: Distribute: $3x+6-2x+10$. Combine like terms: $x+16$.

questions.skill: Use the distributive property
questions.stem: $-3(2x-5)+4x$ is written as $ax+b$. What is $a+b$?

questions.skill: Use the distributive property
questions.stem: Which of these is NOT equal to $12\times15$?

questions.skill: Use the distributive property
questions.stem: For what number $k$ does $2(x+3)+k(x-1)$ have no constant term (no number added or subtracted on its own)?
questions.solution: $2(x+3)=2x+6$ and $k(x-1)=kx-k$. The numbers on their own are $6-k$. This is 0 when $k=6$.

questions.skill: Use the distributive property
questions.stem: Simplify $5(2x-3)-2(5x-4)$. What number is the result?

questions.skill: Simplify by combining like terms
questions.stem: If $2x+3y=10$, what is the value of $4x+6y$?
questions.solution: Since $4x+6y=2(2x+3y)$, its value is $2\times10=20$.

questions.skill: Simplify by combining like terms
questions.stem: The sum $x+2x+3x+\cdots+10x$ (all the multiples of $x$ from $x$ to $10x$) is written as $kx$. What is $k$?
questions.solution: Add the numbers in front of $x$: $1+2+3+\cdots+10=55$.

questions.skill: Simplify by combining like terms
questions.stem: Simplify $x-(2x-(3x-4))$.

questions.skill: Simplify by combining like terms
questions.stem: $4x-7+kx+10$ simplifies to $9x+3$. What number is $k$?
questions.solution: The $x$ terms: $4x+kx=(4+k)x$, and this is $9x$, so $k=5$. Check the numbers: $-7+10=3$.

questions.skill: Simplify by combining like terms
questions.stem: Simplify $5-(x-3)-(2-x)$ to a single number. What is it?
questions.solution: $5-x+3-2+x$. The $x$ terms cancel: $-x+x=0$. The numbers: $5+3-2=6$.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for a given value
questions.stem: What is the value of $3x+5$ when $x=4$?
questions.solution: Replace $x$ with 4: $3\times4+5=12+5=17$. (Multiply before adding.)

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for a given value
questions.stem: Find the value of $20-2y$ when $y=6$.
questions.solution: Replace $y$ with 6: $20-2\times6=20-12=8$.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for a given value
questions.stem: A taxi ride costs 3 dollars plus 2 dollars for every mile. For a ride of $m$ miles, the cost in dollars is $3+2m$. How many dollars does a 7-mile ride cost?
questions.solution: Put $m=7$: $3+2\times7=3+14=17$ dollars.

questions.skill: Translate a phrase into an expression
questions.stem: Which expression means "7 more than $n$"?
questions.solution: "More than" means add: 7 more than $n$ is $n+7$.

questions.skill: Translate a phrase into an expression
questions.stem: Tom has $x$ marbles. Ana has 4 times as many marbles as Tom. If Tom has 6 marbles, how many marbles does Ana have?
questions.solution: Ana has $4x$ marbles. With $x=6$ that is $4\times6=24$.

questions.skill: Translate a phrase into an expression
questions.stem: Which expression means "5 less than twice $y$"?
questions.solution: Twice $y$ is $2y$. Then take away 5: $2y-5$. (The choice $2(y-5)$ means twice "5 less than $y$".)

solve.work: Twice y is 2y; 5 less than that is 2y-5.

questions.skill: Write an expression for a perimeter or an area
questions.stem: A rectangle is $x$ cm long and 5 cm wide. Which expression gives its perimeter in cm?
questions.solution: The perimeter is $x+5+x+5=2x+10$.

questions.skill: Write an expression for a perimeter or an area
questions.stem: A triangle has sides of $a$ cm, $a+2$ cm and $a+3$ cm. If $a=5$, what is the perimeter in cm?
questions.solution: The sides are 5, 7 and 8 cm. Their sum is $5+7+8=20$.

questions.skill: Write an expression for a perimeter or an area
questions.stem: A square has sides of $s$ cm. Each side is made 2 cm longer. Which expression gives the new perimeter in cm?
questions.solution: Each new side is $s+2$ cm and there are four sides, so the perimeter is $4(s+2)=4s+8$.

questions.skill: Combine like terms in one variable
questions.stem: Simplify $4x+3x$.
questions.solution: $4x$ and $3x$ are like terms. Add the numbers in front: $4+3=7$, so the answer is $7x$.

questions.skill: Combine like terms in one variable
questions.stem: When $5x+2x+x$ is simplified it becomes $kx$. What is $k$?
questions.solution: $5x+2x+x=(5+2+1)x=8x$. (Remember that $x$ means $1x$.)

questions.skill: Combine like terms in one variable
questions.stem: Simplify $6y+4-2y+1$.
questions.solution: Combine the $y$ terms: $6y-2y=4y$. Combine the numbers: $4+1=5$. The result is $4y+5$.

questions.skill: Use the distributive property and simplify
questions.stem: Expand $3(x+4)$.
questions.solution: Multiply both terms inside the brackets by 3: $3\times x+3\times4=3x+12$.

questions.skill: Use the distributive property and simplify
questions.stem: $5(x+2)=5x+k$ for every $x$. What is $k$?

questions.skill: Use the distributive property and simplify
questions.stem: Simplify $2(y-3)$.

questions.skill: Simplify expressions with two variables
questions.stem: Simplify $3a+2b+4a$.
questions.solution: Only the $a$ terms are like terms: $3a+4a=7a$. The $2b$ stays. The answer is $7a+2b$.

questions.skill: Simplify expressions with two variables
questions.stem: When $2x+3y+4x+y$ is simplified it becomes $ax+by$. What is $a+b$?

questions.skill: Simplify expressions with two variables
questions.stem: Combine like terms: $5m+3n-2m+n$.
questions.solution: $5m-2m=3m$ and $3n+n=4n$. So the answer is $3m+4n$.

questions.skill: Decide whether expressions are equal
questions.stem: Which expression is equal to $x+x+x$?
questions.solution: Adding $x$ three times is $3\times x=3x$. (A power such as $x^3$ means multiplying.)

questions.skill: Decide whether expressions are equal
questions.stem: For which number $k$ is $3(x+k)$ equal to $3x+15$ for every value of $x$?

questions.skill: Decide whether expressions are equal
questions.stem: Which of these is equal to $2(a+b)$ for all values of $a$ and $b$?
questions.solution: Multiply both $a$ and $b$ by 2: $2(a+b)=2a+2b$.

questions.skill: Translate a sentence into an equation
questions.stem: Which equation says "a number plus 6 equals 15"?
questions.solution: A number is $n$. "Plus 6" gives $n+6$, and "equals 15" gives $n+6=15$.

questions.skill: Translate a sentence into an equation
questions.stem: Four times a number, minus 3, equals 25. What is the number?
questions.solution: As an equation, $4n-3=25$. Add 3: $4n=28$. Then $n=7$.

questions.skill: Translate a sentence into an equation
questions.stem: Which equation says "7 less than $y$ is 20"?
questions.solution: 7 less than $y$ means take 7 away from $y$: $y-7$. So $y-7=20$.

questions.skill: Terms, coefficients and constants
questions.stem: In the expression $7x+3$, what is the coefficient of $x$ (the number multiplying $x$)?
questions.solution: The coefficient is the number multiplying the variable. Here it is 7.

questions.skill: Terms, coefficients and constants
questions.stem: How many terms does the expression $4a-5b+9$ have?
questions.solution: The terms are $4a$, $-5b$ and $9$. That is 3 terms.

questions.skill: Terms, coefficients and constants
questions.stem: What is the constant term in $5x-8+2x$?
questions.solution: The constant term has no variable. The only one is $-8$. (The terms $5x$ and $2x$ both have $x$.)

questions.skill: Substitute and use a given relationship
questions.stem: If $a=2b$ and $b=5$, what is $a$?
questions.solution: Replace $b$ with 5: $a=2\times5=10$.

questions.skill: Substitute and use a given relationship
questions.stem: A bag of $n$ apples costs $c=4n$ dollars. How many dollars does the bag cost when $n=6$?
questions.solution: Put $n=6$: $c=4\times6=24$.

questions.skill: Substitute and use a given relationship
questions.stem: If $y=3$, what is the value of $y+y+y+y$?

questions.skill: Expressions for totals, rates and amounts left
questions.stem: Ben buys $p$ pencils at 3 cents each. Which expression gives the cost in cents?
questions.solution: Each pencil costs 3 cents, so $p$ pencils cost $3\times p=3p$ cents.

questions.skill: Expressions for totals, rates and amounts left
questions.stem: A class has 4 groups of $g$ students, and 2 teachers. How many people are in the class when $g=6$?
questions.solution: The students are $4g=24$, and adding the 2 teachers gives $4g+2=26$.

questions.skill: Expressions for totals, rates and amounts left
questions.stem: Jack had $k$ cards and gave 5 of them away. Which expression shows how many he has left?
questions.solution: Giving away means taking away: $k-5$.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for a given value
questions.stem: Evaluate $x^2-3x+4$ when $x=5$.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for a given value
questions.stem: What is the value of $\frac{2a+b}{3}$ when $a=6$ and $b=9$?
questions.solution: First the top: $2\times6+9=21$. Then divide the whole top by 3: $21\div3=7$.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for a given value
questions.stem: What is the value of $4x^2-x+1$ when $x=-2$?

questions.skill: Translate a phrase into an expression
questions.stem: A notebook costs $n$ dollars and a pen costs 2 dollars less than a notebook. Which expression gives the total cost, in dollars, of 3 notebooks and 4 pens?
questions.solution: A pen costs $n-2$ dollars. So 3 notebooks and 4 pens cost $3n+4(n-2)$ dollars.

questions.skill: Translate a phrase into an expression
questions.stem: A number $x$ is tripled and then 7 is subtracted. This gives the expression $3x-7$. What is its value when $x=11$?

questions.skill: Translate a phrase into an expression
questions.stem: Which expression means "the product of 6 and the sum of $a$ and $b$, decreased by $c$"?
questions.solution: The sum of $a$ and $b$ is $a+b$. The product of 6 and that sum is $6(a+b)$. Decreased by $c$ means subtract $c$.

solve.work: Product of 6 and (a+b) is 6(a+b); decreased by c gives 6(a+b)-c. The comma separates "decreased by c" from the product.

questions.skill: Write an expression for a perimeter or an area
questions.stem: A rectangle's length is 3 more than twice its width $w$. Which expression gives its perimeter?
questions.solution: The length is $2w+3$. The perimeter is $2\times(w+2w+3)=2\times(3w+3)=6w+6$.

questions.skill: Write an expression for a perimeter or an area
questions.stem: A rectangular garden is $2x+1$ meters long and $x$ meters wide. When $x=5$, what is the perimeter in meters?
questions.solution: The length is $2\times5+1=11$ and the width is 5. The perimeter is $2\times(11+5)=32$ meters.

questions.skill: Write an expression for a perimeter or an area
questions.stem: A rectangle is $w$ cm wide and $w+6$ cm long. Which expression gives its area in square cm?
questions.solution: Area is width times length: $w(w+6)=w^2+6w$. (The choice $2w+12$ is the perimeter, not the area.)

questions.skill: Combine like terms in one variable
questions.stem: Which expression is equal to $3a-5+7a-9$?
questions.solution: $3a+7a=10a$ and $-5-9=-14$. So the result is $10a-14$.

questions.skill: Combine like terms in one variable
questions.stem: Simplify $9x-4+2x+10$ to the form $ax+b$. What is $a+b$?
questions.solution: $9x+2x=11x$ and $-4+10=6$, so the expression is $11x+6$. Then $a+b=11+6=17$.

questions.skill: Combine like terms in one variable
questions.stem: Simplify $x^2+5x+3x^2-2x$.
questions.solution: $x^2$ and $3x^2$ are like terms: $x^2+3x^2=4x^2$. Also $5x-2x=3x$. The terms with $x^2$ and with $x$ are not like terms, so they stay apart.

questions.skill: Use the distributive property and simplify
questions.stem: Simplify $4(2x+1)+3x$.

questions.skill: Use the distributive property and simplify
questions.stem: When $3(a+5)-2(a+1)$ is simplified, it becomes $a+k$. What is $k$?

questions.skill: Use the distributive property and simplify
questions.stem: Which expression is equal to $-(x-6)+2x$?
questions.solution: The minus sign flips both signs inside: $-(x-6)=-x+6$. Then $-x+6+2x=x+6$.

questions.skill: Simplify expressions with two variables
questions.stem: Simplify $4xy+3x-xy+2y$.
questions.solution: The only like terms are $4xy$ and $-xy$, which make $3xy$. The terms $3x$ and $2y$ are not like terms of anything else, so they stay.

questions.skill: Simplify expressions with two variables
questions.stem: Simplify $7a-2b-3a+5b$. What is its value when $a=2$ and $b=3$?
questions.solution: $7a-3a=4a$ and $-2b+5b=3b$, so the expression is $4a+3b$. With $a=2$, $b=3$: $8+9=17$.

questions.skill: Simplify expressions with two variables
questions.stem: What is $(6x+2y)+(x-5y)$ in simplest form?
questions.solution: $6x+x=7x$ and $2y-5y=-3y$. So the sum is $7x-3y$.

questions.skill: Decide whether expressions are equal
questions.stem: Which statement is true for every number $x$?
questions.solution: $3x-x=2x$ is true. Test $x=3$ in the others: $3+3=6$ but $3^2=9$; $2(6)=12$ but $2\times3+3=9$; $3\cdot3=9$ but $2\times3=6$.

solve.work: 3x-x=2x always; others fail e.g. at x=1.

questions.skill: Decide whether expressions are equal
questions.stem: For how many of the numbers $x=1,2,3,4$ do $3x+6$ and $2x+8$ have the same value?
questions.solution: Try each number. At $x=1$: 9 and 10. At $x=2$: 12 and 12, equal. At $x=3$: 15 and 14. At $x=4$: 18 and 16. Only $x=2$ works, so the answer is 1.

solve.work: 3x+6=2x+8 gives x=2 only; one value in the list.

questions.skill: Decide whether expressions are equal
questions.stem: Which pair of expressions has the same value for every $x$?
questions.solution: $5x+2x=7x$ for every $x$. The other pairs fail when $x=2$: $5x+2x=14$ but $7x^2=28$; $5x-2x=6$ but $7x=14$; $5x+2=12$ but $7x=14$.

questions.skill: Translate a sentence into an equation
questions.stem: Sara has $s$ dollars. Her brother has 5 dollars more than twice what Sara has. Together they have 38 dollars. Which equation shows this?
questions.solution: Her brother has $2s+5$ dollars. Together: $s+(2s+5)=38$.

questions.skill: Translate a sentence into an equation
questions.stem: Three times the sum of a number and 4 equals 33. What is the number?
questions.solution: As an equation, $3(n+4)=33$. Divide by 3: $n+4=11$. So $n=7$.

questions.skill: Translate a sentence into an equation
questions.stem: Which sentence matches the equation $3(x-2)=15$?
choices: Subtracting 2 from three times a number gives 15
Three times a number is 2 less than 15
Three more than a number, minus 2, is 15
Three times the difference of a number and 2 is 15
questions.answer: Three times the difference of a number and 2 is 15
questions.solution: In $3(x-2)$ we first subtract 2 from the number, then multiply the result by 3. That is "three times the difference of a number and 2".

solve.answer: Three times the difference of a number and 2 is 15
solve.work: 3(x-2): three times the difference of a number and 2.

questions.skill: Terms, coefficients and constants
questions.stem: After like terms are combined, what is the coefficient of $y$ in $3y+5-y+4y$?
questions.solution: $3y-y+4y=(3-1+4)y=6y$. The coefficient is 6.

questions.skill: Terms, coefficients and constants
questions.stem: The expression $3x+2y-x+5-4y+7$ is simplified by combining like terms. How many terms does the result have?
questions.solution: The result is $2x-2y+12$. It has 3 terms.

questions.skill: Terms, coefficients and constants
questions.stem: Which expression has a coefficient of $-3$ on $x$ after it is simplified?
questions.solution: $2x-5x=-3x$. The others give $3x$, $-x$ and $-2x$.

questions.skill: Substitute and use a given relationship
questions.stem: If $a=3b$, which expression is equal to $a+2b$?
questions.solution: Replace $a$ with $3b$: $3b+2b=5b$.

questions.skill: Substitute and use a given relationship
questions.stem: If $x=2y+1$ and $y=4$, what is the value of $3x-y$?
questions.solution: First $x=2\times4+1=9$. Then $3x-y=27-4=23$.

questions.skill: Substitute and use a given relationship
questions.stem: If $m=n-4$, which expression is equal to $3m+n$?
questions.solution: Replace $m$ with $n-4$: $3(n-4)+n=3n-12+n=4n-12$.

questions.skill: Expressions for totals, rates and amounts left
questions.stem: Tickets cost 8 dollars for an adult and 5 dollars for a child. A group has $a$ adults and $c$ children. Which expression gives the total cost in dollars?
questions.solution: $a$ adults pay $8a$ dollars and $c$ children pay $5c$ dollars. The total is $8a+5c$.

questions.skill: Expressions for totals, rates and amounts left
questions.stem: A plumber charges 45 dollars for the visit plus 30 dollars for each hour of work. How many dollars does a 3-hour job cost?
questions.solution: The cost is $45+30\times3=45+90=135$ dollars.

questions.skill: Expressions for totals, rates and amounts left
questions.stem: A tank holds $T$ liters of water. It drains at 15 liters every minute. Which expression gives the liters left after $m$ minutes?
questions.solution: In $m$ minutes, $15m$ liters drain away. What is left is $T-15m$.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for a given value
questions.stem: For which value of $x$ does $2x^2-3x$ equal 20?
questions.solution: Try each. At $x=4$: $2\times16-12=32-12=20$. At $x=5$ the value is 35, at $x=3$ it is 9, and at $x=-2$ it is 14. Only 4 works.

solve.work: 2x^2-3x-20=(2x+5)(x-4)=0 so x=4 or -5/2. Check options: 4 gives 32-12=20; 3 gives 9; 5 gives 35; -2 gives 14. Only 4 works.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for a given value
questions.stem: What is the value of $\frac{x}{2}+\frac{x}{3}+\frac{x}{6}$ when $x=2026$? (Look for a shortcut.)
questions.solution: Combine first: $\frac{x}{2}+\frac{x}{3}+\frac{x}{6}=\frac{3x+2x+x}{6}=\frac{6x}{6}=x$. So the value is 2026.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression for a given value
questions.stem: Let $n=7$. Which of these expressions has the greatest value?

questions.skill: Translate a phrase into an expression
questions.stem: Ruth is $r$ years old. Her father is 4 years older than three times her age. Which expression gives her father's age 5 years from now?
questions.solution: Her father's age now is $3r+4$. In 5 years it is $3r+4+5=3r+9$.

questions.skill: Translate a phrase into an expression
questions.stem: A gym charges a joining fee of 30 dollars and 18 dollars for each month. Let $m$ be the number of months. What is the total cost, in dollars, for 6 months?
questions.solution: The cost is $30+18m$ dollars. For 6 months: $30+18\times6=30+108=138$.

questions.skill: Translate a phrase into an expression
questions.stem: Four consecutive whole numbers start at $n$: they are $n$, $n+1$, $n+2$ and $n+3$. Which expression is their sum?

questions.skill: Write an expression for a perimeter or an area
questions.stem: A picture is $p$ cm wide and $2p$ cm long. A frame 3 cm wide goes all the way around it. Which expression gives the perimeter of the outside edge of the frame, in cm?
questions.solution: The outside edge is $p+6$ cm wide and $2p+6$ cm long (3 cm is added on each side). Perimeter: $2\times(p+6+2p+6)=2\times(3p+12)=6p+24$.

questions.skill: Write an expression for a perimeter or an area
questions.stem: A rectangle is $a$ cm long and $b$ cm wide, with $a=10$ and $b=7$. Its length is made 3 cm longer and its width 2 cm shorter. What is the perimeter of the new rectangle in cm?
questions.solution: The new length is $10+3=13$ and the new width is $7-2=5$. The perimeter is $2\times(13+5)=36$ cm.

questions.skill: Write an expression for a perimeter or an area
questions.stem: The perimeter of a rectangle is $20x$ cm and its width is $3x$ cm. Which expression gives its length in cm?
questions.solution: Half the perimeter is length plus width: $10x$. So the length is $10x-3x=7x$.

questions.skill: Combine like terms in one variable
questions.stem: What is $9x-3x+x-7x$ in simplest form?
questions.solution: Add the numbers in front of $x$ in order: $9-3+1-7=0$. So the whole expression is $0x=0$.

questions.skill: Combine like terms in one variable
questions.stem: After like terms are combined, $5x+kx-9+2x+4$ equals $3x-5$. What is $k$?
questions.solution: Combining gives $(5+k+2)x-5$. This must equal $3x-5$, so $5+k+2=3$ and $k=-4$.

questions.skill: Combine like terms in one variable
questions.stem: Which of these expressions is NOT equal to $8x+4$ for every value of $x$?
questions.solution: $8(x+4)=8x+32$, which is different. The others all simplify to $8x+4$: $4(2x+1)=8x+4$, $2x+6x=8x$, and $12x-4x=8x$.

questions.skill: Use the distributive property and simplify
questions.stem: When $2(3x-4)-3(x-5)$ is simplified, it becomes $3x+k$. What is $k$?

questions.skill: Use the distributive property and simplify
questions.stem: Simplify $5-2(x-3)+x$.
questions.solution: $-2(x-3)=-2x+6$. So the expression is $5-2x+6+x=11-x$.

questions.skill: Use the distributive property and simplify
questions.stem: What is $\frac{1}{2}(6x+8)-\frac{1}{3}(9x-12)$ in simplest form?

questions.skill: Simplify expressions with two variables
questions.stem: When $(5a+3b)-(2a-4b)$ is simplified, it becomes $pa+qb$. What is $p+q$?
questions.solution: Subtracting changes both signs: $5a+3b-2a+4b=3a+7b$. So $p=3$, $q=7$, and $p+q=10$.

questions.skill: Simplify expressions with two variables
questions.stem: Simplify $3(2x-y)-2(x-3y)$.

questions.skill: Simplify expressions with two variables
questions.stem: Suppose $x+y=9$. Group the terms to find the value of $3x+3y-5$.

questions.skill: Decide whether expressions are equal
questions.stem: Find the number $k$ for which $3(2x+k)-x$ and $5x+12$ are equal for every value of $x$.
questions.solution: $3(2x+k)-x=6x+3k-x=5x+3k$. This equals $5x+12$ when $3k=12$, so $k=4$.

questions.skill: Decide whether expressions are equal
questions.stem: For which number $c$ is $c(x+2)+3x$ equal to $8x+10$ for every value of $x$?
questions.solution: $c(x+2)+3x=(c+3)x+2c$. We need $c+3=8$ and $2c=10$. Both give $c=5$.

questions.skill: Decide whether expressions are equal
questions.stem: Which of these is equal to $4(x-3)-(x-3)$ for every $x$?
questions.solution: $4(x-3)=4x-12$. Subtracting $(x-3)$ means subtracting $x$ and adding 3: $4x-12-x+3=3x-9$. (Or: 4 of something minus 1 of it leaves 3 of it, $3(x-3)$.)

questions.skill: Translate a sentence into an equation
questions.stem: Jo is $j$ years old and her sister is 3 years younger. In 6 years the sum of their ages will be 41. Which equation shows this?
questions.solution: In 6 years Jo will be $j+6$. Her sister is $j-3$ now and will be $j-3+6=j+3$. So the sum is $(j+6)+(j+3)=41$.

solve.work: Sister j-3. In 6 years: j+6 and j+3. (j+6)+(j+3)=41.

questions.skill: Translate a sentence into an equation
questions.stem: A number is doubled and then 5 is subtracted. The result equals the number increased by 9. What is the number?
questions.solution: The equation is $2n-5=n+9$. Take away $n$ from both sides: $n-5=9$. Then $n=14$.

questions.skill: Translate a sentence into an equation
questions.stem: The sum of three consecutive whole numbers is 72. What is the smallest of them?
questions.solution: Call the numbers $n$, $n+1$, $n+2$. Their sum is $3n+3=72$, so $3n=69$ and $n=23$. (23, 24, 25 add to 72.)

questions.skill: Terms, coefficients and constants
questions.stem: $4x+7-(kx-2)$ simplifies to an expression whose coefficient of $x$ is $-2$. What is $k$?
questions.solution: Remove the brackets: $4x+7-kx+2=(4-k)x+9$. We need $4-k=-2$, so $k=6$.

questions.skill: Terms, coefficients and constants
questions.stem: Which statement is true about $3(x+2)-3x+4$?
choices: It equals 10 for every value of $x$
It equals $6x+10$ for every value of $x$
It gets bigger when $x$ gets bigger
questions.answer: It equals 10 for every value of $x$
questions.solution: $3(x+2)=3x+6$. Then $3x+6-3x+4=10$. The $x$ terms cancel, so the value is always 10.

solve.answer: It equals 10 for every value of $x$

questions.skill: Terms, coefficients and constants
questions.stem: After simplifying, which expression has the greatest coefficient of $x$?
questions.solution: The coefficients are: $3+4-2=5$; $10-3=7$; $6-1=5$; and $6$. The greatest is 7, from $10x-3(x+1)$.

questions.skill: Substitute and use a given relationship
questions.stem: If $a=2b$ and $b=3c$, what is the value of $a+b+c$ when $c=2$?
questions.solution: First $b=3\times2=6$. Then $a=2\times6=12$. So $a+b+c=12+6+2=20$.

questions.skill: Substitute and use a given relationship
questions.stem: If $x+2y=10$, what is the value of $3x+6y$?
questions.solution: Notice that $3x+6y=3(x+2y)=3\times10=30$.

questions.skill: Substitute and use a given relationship
questions.stem: If $x-2y=4$, what is the value of $5x-10y$?

questions.skill: Expressions for totals, rates and amounts left
questions.stem: A pen costs $p$ dollars. A notebook costs 3 dollars more than a pen. Which expression gives the cost, in dollars, of 2 pens and 3 notebooks?
questions.solution: A notebook costs $p+3$. So 2 pens and 3 notebooks cost $2p+3(p+3)=2p+3p+9=5p+9$ dollars.

questions.skill: Expressions for totals, rates and amounts left
questions.stem: A car drives at 50 miles per hour for $h$ hours and then at 30 miles per hour for 2 more hours. How many miles does it drive in all when $h=4$?
questions.solution: The distance is $50h+30\times2$. With $h=4$: $200+60=260$ miles.

questions.skill: Expressions for totals, rates and amounts left
questions.stem: A school buys $n$ boxes of markers with 24 markers in each box, and then gives away 10 markers. How many markers are left when $n=5$?
questions.solution: The markers left are $24n-10$. With $n=5$: $120-10=110$.

questions.skill: Solve a one-step or two-step equation
questions.stem: Solve $x+9=17$.
questions.solution: Take 9 away from both sides: $x=17-9=8$.

questions.skill: Solve a one-step or two-step equation
questions.stem: What is the solution of $5x=35$?
questions.solution: Divide both sides by 5: $x=35\div5=7$.

questions.skill: Solve a one-step or two-step equation
questions.stem: Solve $3x-4=14$.
questions.solution: Add 4 to both sides: $3x=18$. Divide by 3: $x=6$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with the variable on both sides
questions.stem: Solve $3x+2=x+10$.
questions.solution: Subtract $x$ from both sides: $2x+2=10$. Subtract 2: $2x=8$. So $x=4$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with the variable on both sides
questions.stem: Solve $5x=2x+12$.
questions.solution: Subtract $2x$ from both sides: $3x=12$. So $x=4$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with the variable on both sides
questions.stem: What is $x$ if $x+14=3x$?
questions.solution: Subtract $x$ from both sides: $14=2x$. So $x=7$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with parentheses
questions.solution: Divide both sides by 2: $x+3=7$. Then $x=4$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with parentheses
questions.solution: Divide both sides by 3: $x-1=4$. Add 1: $x=5$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with parentheses
questions.solution: Multiply out: $4x-8=20$. Add 8: $4x=28$. So $x=7$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with fraction coefficients
questions.stem: Solve $\frac{x}{3}=5$.
questions.solution: Multiply both sides by 3: $x=15$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with fraction coefficients
questions.stem: Solve $\frac{x}{4}+2=6$.
questions.solution: Subtract 2: $\frac{x}{4}=4$. Multiply by 4: $x=16$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with fraction coefficients
questions.stem: Solve $\frac{2x}{3}=8$.
questions.solution: Multiply both sides by 3: $2x=24$. Divide by 2: $x=12$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with fractions on both sides
questions.stem: Solve $\frac{x}{5}=\frac{6}{10}$.
questions.solution: $\frac{6}{10}=\frac{3}{5}$, so $x=3$. (Or multiply both sides by 5: $x=\frac{30}{10}=3$.)

questions.skill: Solve an equation with fractions on both sides
questions.stem: Solve $\frac{x}{8}=\frac{3}{4}$.
questions.solution: Multiply both sides by 8: $x=\frac{3\times8}{4}=6$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with fractions on both sides
questions.stem: Solve $\frac{3}{x}=\frac{1}{4}$.
questions.solution: Cross-multiply: $3\times4=1\times x$, so $x=12$.

questions.skill: Solve a number puzzle with an equation
questions.stem: Seven more than a number is 19. What is the number?
questions.solution: Let the number be $n$. Then $n+7=19$, so $n=12$.

questions.skill: Solve a number puzzle with an equation
questions.stem: When 8 is subtracted from a number, the result is 15. What is the number?

questions.skill: Solve a number puzzle with an equation
questions.stem: Half of a number is 11. What is the number?

questions.skill: Consecutive numbers and ages
questions.stem: Two consecutive whole numbers add up to 25. What is the smaller one?
questions.solution: Call them $n$ and $n+1$. Then $2n+1=25$, so $2n=24$ and $n=12$. (12 and 13.)

questions.skill: Consecutive numbers and ages
questions.stem: Mina is 4 years older than Sam. Together their ages add up to 20. How old is Sam?
questions.solution: Sam is $s$ and Mina is $s+4$. Then $2s+4=20$, so $s=8$. (Mina is 12.)

questions.skill: Consecutive numbers and ages
questions.stem: Leo is 3 times as old as his sister. Together they are 24 years old. How old is his sister?
questions.solution: Sister is $s$, Leo is $3s$. Then $4s=24$, so $s=6$.

questions.skill: Money problems
questions.stem: Pat buys 4 notebooks that cost the same and one pen for 2 dollars. The total is 18 dollars. How many dollars does one notebook cost?

questions.skill: Money problems
questions.stem: Ravi has 6 dollars. He saves the same amount every week. After 5 weeks he has 31 dollars. How many dollars does he save each week?

questions.skill: Money problems
questions.stem: Ana has 3 times as much money as Ben. Together they have 48 dollars. How many dollars does Ben have?
questions.solution: Ben has $b$ and Ana has $3b$. Then $4b=48$, so $b=12$.

questions.skill: Distance, perimeter and rate problems
questions.stem: A cyclist rides at 12 miles per hour. For how many hours must she ride to go 60 miles?
questions.solution: $12t=60$, so $t=5$ hours.

questions.skill: Distance, perimeter and rate problems
questions.stem: A rectangle is 5 cm wide and its perimeter is 26 cm. How long is it, in cm?

questions.skill: Distance, perimeter and rate problems
questions.stem: A tank has 20 liters of water. It fills at 5 liters every minute. After how many minutes does it hold 65 liters?

questions.skill: Equations with no solution or with every number as a solution
questions.stem: How many solutions does $x+3=x+5$ have?
questions.solution: Subtract $x$ from both sides: $3=5$. That is never true, so no number $x$ works.

questions.skill: Equations with no solution or with every number as a solution
questions.stem: Which of these equations is true for every number $x$?
questions.solution: $2(x+1)=2x+2$, so both sides are always equal. The choice $2(x+1)=x+2$ is true only when $x=0$, and the other two are never true.

questions.skill: Equations with no solution or with every number as a solution
questions.stem: For which number $k$ is the equation $x+7=x+k$ true for every value of $x$?
questions.solution: Both sides must be the same expression, so $k=7$.

questions.skill: Use an equation to find another value
questions.stem: If $x+4=9$, what is the value of $x+10$?

questions.skill: Use an equation to find another value
questions.stem: Which of these numbers is a solution of $2x+1=9$?
questions.solution: Try 4: $2\times4+1=9$. The other numbers give 11, 7 and 17.

questions.skill: Use an equation to find another value
questions.stem: If $3x=12$, what is the value of $6x$?
questions.solution: $6x$ is twice $3x$, so $6x=2\times12=24$. (Or find $x=4$ and then $6\times4=24$.)

questions.skill: Solve a one-step or two-step equation
questions.stem: Solve $7-2x=1$.
questions.solution: Subtract 7 from both sides: $-2x=-6$. Divide by $-2$: $x=3$. Check: $7-2\times3=1$.

questions.skill: Solve a one-step or two-step equation
questions.stem: Solve $4x+7=3$.
questions.solution: Subtract 7 from both sides: $4x=-4$. Divide by 4: $x=-1$.

questions.skill: Solve a one-step or two-step equation
questions.stem: Find the value of $x$ that makes $12=5x-8$ true.
questions.solution: Add 8 to both sides: $20=5x$. Divide by 5: $x=4$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with the variable on both sides
Solve an equation with the variable on both sides
questions.stem: Solve $9-2x=x-6$.
questions.solution: Add $2x$ to both sides: $9=3x-6$. Add 6: $15=3x$. So $x=5$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with the variable on both sides
questions.stem: Solve $4x+7=7x-5$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with parentheses
questions.solution: Multiply out: $3x+6=2x+10$. Subtract $2x$: $x+6=10$. So $x=4$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with parentheses
questions.solution: Multiply out: $6x-2=4x+8$. Subtract $4x$: $2x-2=8$. Add 2: $2x=10$. So $x=5$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with parentheses
questions.solution: The minus sign changes both signs inside: $5-x+3=2$, so $8-x=2$. Then $x=6$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with fraction coefficients
questions.stem: Solve $\frac{x}{2}+\frac{x}{3}=10$.
questions.solution: Multiply every term by 6: $3x+2x=60$, so $5x=60$ and $x=12$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with fraction coefficients
questions.stem: Solve $\frac{3}{4}x-2=7$.
questions.solution: Add 2: $\frac34x=9$. Multiply by 4: $3x=36$. So $x=12$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with fraction coefficients
questions.stem: Solve $\frac{x+3}{5}=4$.
questions.solution: Multiply both sides by 5: $x+3=20$. Subtract 3: $x=17$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with fractions on both sides
questions.stem: Solve $\frac{x+1}{2}=\frac{x-1}{3}$.
questions.solution: Multiply both sides by 6: $3(x+1)=2(x-1)$, so $3x+3=2x-2$. Then $x=-5$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with fractions on both sides
questions.stem: Solve $\frac{2x-1}{3}=\frac{x+4}{2}$.
questions.solution: Multiply both sides by 6: $2(2x-1)=3(x+4)$, so $4x-2=3x+12$. Then $x=14$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with fractions on both sides
questions.stem: What value of $x$ makes $\frac{x}{2}+1$ equal to $\frac{x}{3}+3$?
questions.solution: Subtract 1 and $\frac{x}{3}$ from both sides: $\frac{x}{2}-\frac{x}{3}=2$, which is $\frac{x}{6}=2$. So $x=12$.

questions.skill: Solve a number puzzle with an equation
questions.stem: Five more than three times a number is 29. What is the number?

questions.skill: Solve a number puzzle with an equation
questions.stem: If you subtract a number from 51, the result is 9 more than the number. What is the number?

questions.skill: Solve a number puzzle with an equation
questions.stem: Twice a number, plus 7, equals the number plus 20. What is the number?

questions.skill: Consecutive numbers and ages
questions.stem: Four consecutive even numbers add up to 100. What is the smallest of them?

questions.skill: Consecutive numbers and ages
questions.stem: Three consecutive odd numbers add up to 75. What is the largest of them?
questions.solution: Call them $n$, $n+2$, $n+4$. Then $3n+6=75$, so $n=23$. The numbers are 23, 25, 27, so the largest is 27.

questions.skill: Consecutive numbers and ages
questions.stem: In 5 years, Ella will be twice as old as she was 3 years ago. How old is Ella now?
questions.solution: Let Ella be $e$ now. In 5 years she is $e+5$, and 3 years ago she was $e-3$. So $e+5=2(e-3)$, which is $e+5=2e-6$. Then $e=11$.

questions.skill: Money problems
questions.stem: Jo has 12 coins, all dimes (10 cents each) and quarters (25 cents each). They are worth 210 cents in all. How many quarters does Jo have?
questions.solution: Let $d$ be the dimes; then there are $12-d$ quarters. $10d+25(12-d)=210$, so $300-15d=210$ and $d=6$. So there are $12-6=6$ quarters.

questions.skill: Money problems
questions.stem: A show sells 40 tickets. Adult tickets cost 5 dollars and student tickets cost 3 dollars. The sales are 150 dollars. How many adult tickets were sold?
questions.solution: Let $a$ be adult tickets; then $40-a$ are student tickets. $5a+3(40-a)=150$, so $2a+120=150$ and $a=15$.

questions.skill: Money problems
questions.stem: Sam earns 12 dollars for each hour of work plus a bonus of 30 dollars. For how many hours must Sam work to earn 150 dollars?

questions.skill: Distance, perimeter and rate problems
questions.stem: A bus leaves a station at 60 miles per hour. Two hours later a car leaves the same station on the same road at 90 miles per hour. How many hours after the car leaves does it catch up with the bus?
questions.solution: Let $s$ be the car's hours. The bus has been driving $s+2$ hours. They are at the same spot when $90s=60(s+2)$. So $30s=120$ and $s=4$. (Both have gone 360 miles.)

solve.work: Bus is 120 miles ahead; gap closes at 30 mph: 4 hours.

questions.skill: Distance, perimeter and rate problems
questions.stem: The sides of a triangle are $x$ cm, $x+4$ cm and $2x-1$ cm. Its perimeter is 43 cm. What is $x$?

questions.skill: Distance, perimeter and rate problems
questions.stem: Two cars start 300 miles apart and drive toward each other. One goes 45 miles per hour and the other 55 miles per hour. After how many hours do they meet?
questions.solution: Together they close 100 miles each hour: $45t+55t=300$, so $100t=300$ and $t=3$.

questions.skill: Equations with no solution or with every number as a solution
questions.stem: Which statement is true about the equation $3(x+2)=3x+6$?
questions.solution: $3(x+2)=3x+6$. The two sides are the same expression, so the equation is true for every value of $x$.

questions.skill: Equations with no solution or with every number as a solution
questions.stem: How many of the whole numbers from 1 to 10 are solutions of $2(x+3)=2x+6$?
questions.solution: Multiplying out, the left side is $2x+6$, the same as the right side. So every number is a solution, including all 10 of these.

questions.skill: Equations with no solution or with every number as a solution
questions.stem: Which statement is true about the equation $4x+2=2(2x+1)+1$?
choices: It is true for every value of $x$
questions.solution: The right side is $4x+2+1=4x+3$. Then $4x+2=4x+3$ becomes $2=3$, which is never true. There is no solution.

questions.skill: Use an equation to find another value
questions.stem: If $4x-3=13$, what is the value of $x+2$?

questions.skill: Use an equation to find another value
questions.stem: If $2x+6=20$, what is the value of $x+3$?

questions.skill: Use an equation to find another value
questions.stem: Ned writes $3(x-2)=x+8$ and then $3x-2=x+8$, which is a mistake. What is the correct solution of $3(x-2)=x+8$?
questions.solution: Multiply out correctly: $3x-6=x+8$. Subtract $x$: $2x-6=8$. Add 6: $2x=14$. So $x=7$.

questions.skill: Solve a one-step or two-step equation
questions.solution: Subtract 1.2 from both sides: $0.3x=2.1$. Divide by 0.3: $x=7$.

questions.skill: Solve a one-step or two-step equation
questions.solution: Add 7 to both sides: $-3x=21$. Divide by $-3$: $x=-7$.

questions.skill: Solve a one-step or two-step equation
questions.stem: Which of these equations has the solution $x=-2$?
questions.solution: Put $x=-2$ into $3x+4$: $3\times(-2)+4=-6+4=-2$. So $3x+4=-2$ works. The others have solutions $x=2$, $x=2$ and $x=-6$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with the variable on both sides
questions.solution: Subtract $2024x$ from both sides: $x-17=3$. Add 17: $x=20$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with the variable on both sides
questions.solution: Add $3x$ to both sides: $8=5x-17$. Add 17: $25=5x$. So $x=5$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with the variable on both sides
questions.stem: The expression $6x-7$ is 13 more than the expression $2x+4$. What is $x$?

questions.skill: Solve an equation with parentheses
questions.solution: Multiply out: $6x-15-2x-8=1$. Combine: $4x-23=1$. Add 23: $4x=24$. So $x=6$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with parentheses
questions.solution: Multiply out: $x-2x+9=3x-15$, so $-x+9=3x-15$. Add $x$ and add 15: $24=4x$. So $x=6$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with parentheses
questions.solution: Left side: $7-6x+3=10-6x$. Right side: $12-4x-5=7-4x$. So $10-6x=7-4x$. Add $6x$: $10=7+2x$. Then $2x=3$ and $x=\frac32$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with fraction coefficients
questions.stem: Solve $\frac{2}{3}x+\frac{1}{2}=\frac{5}{6}x-1$.
questions.solution: Multiply every term by 6: $4x+3=5x-6$. Subtract $4x$: $3=x-6$. So $x=9$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with fraction coefficients
questions.stem: Solve $\frac{x}{2}-\frac{x}{5}=6$.
questions.solution: Multiply every term by 10: $5x-2x=60$, so $3x=60$ and $x=20$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with fraction coefficients
questions.solution: Multiply out: $\frac{x}{4}-2+\frac{x}{2}=7$. Multiply every term by 4: $x-8+2x=28$, so $3x=36$ and $x=12$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with fractions on both sides
questions.stem: Solve $\frac{x-1}{3}-\frac{x-3}{6}=1$.
questions.solution: Multiply every term by 6: $2(x-1)-(x-3)=6$. So $2x-2-x+3=6$, which is $x+1=6$. Then $x=5$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with fractions on both sides
questions.stem: Solve $\frac{5}{x}=\frac{15}{x+6}$.
questions.solution: Cross-multiply: $5(x+6)=15x$, so $5x+30=15x$. Then $30=10x$ and $x=3$. Check: $\frac53=\frac{15}{9}$.

questions.skill: Solve an equation with fractions on both sides
questions.stem: Three-fourths of $x+2$ equals two-thirds of $x+5$. What is $x$?
questions.solution: The equation is $\frac34(x+2)=\frac23(x+5)$. Multiply by 12: $9(x+2)=8(x+5)$, so $9x+18=8x+40$. Then $x=22$.

questions.skill: Solve a number puzzle with an equation
questions.stem: A number is multiplied by 5 and then 12 is subtracted. The result is the same as when the number is taken away from 36. What is the number?

questions.skill: Solve a number puzzle with an equation
questions.stem: Two-thirds of a number is 4 more than half of the number. What is the number?
questions.solution: $\frac23n=\frac12n+4$. Multiply by 6: $4n=3n+24$. So $n=24$.

questions.skill: Solve a number puzzle with an equation
questions.stem: The sum of two numbers is 40 and their difference is 12. What is the larger number?
questions.solution: Let the larger be $n$. Then the smaller is $n-12$, and $n+(n-12)=40$. So $2n=52$ and $n=26$. (The smaller is 14.)

questions.skill: Consecutive numbers and ages
questions.stem: The sum of three consecutive whole numbers is 12 more than twice the largest of them. What is the smallest of the three?

questions.skill: Consecutive numbers and ages
questions.stem: A mother is 4 times as old as her daughter. In 6 years, the mother will be 3 times as old as her daughter. How old is the daughter now?
questions.solution: Daughter is $d$, mother is $4d$. In 6 years: $4d+6=3(d+6)=3d+18$. So $d=12$. (Mother is 48.)

questions.skill: Consecutive numbers and ages
questions.stem: Ben is 5 years older than Amy. Four years ago, Ben was twice as old as Amy was then. How old is Ben now?
questions.solution: Amy is $a$ now and Ben is $a+5$. Four years ago: $a+5-4=2(a-4)$, so $a+1=2a-8$ and $a=9$. Ben is $9+5=14$.

questions.skill: Money problems
questions.stem: Plan A costs 10 dollars a month plus 5 cents per minute of calls. Plan B costs 4 dollars a month plus 15 cents per minute. For how many minutes in a month do the two plans cost the same?
questions.solution: Work in dollars: $10+0.05m=4+0.15m$. Subtract $0.05m$ and 4: $6=0.10m$. So $m=60$. (Both cost 13 dollars.)

questions.skill: Money problems
questions.stem: Ela buys 8 items, some pens at 3 dollars each and the rest notebooks at 5 dollars each. She pays 32 dollars. How many notebooks did she buy?
questions.solution: Let $n$ be notebooks; pens are $8-n$. $3(8-n)+5n=32$, so $24+2n=32$ and $n=4$.

questions.skill: Money problems
questions.stem: Lena spent half of her money, and then 8 dollars more. She has 11 dollars left. How many dollars did she start with?
questions.solution: Let her start with $x$. Then $x-\frac{x}{2}-8=11$, so $\frac{x}{2}=19$ and $x=38$.

questions.skill: Distance, perimeter and rate problems
questions.stem: A rectangle's length is 4 more than 3 times its width. Its perimeter is 56 cm. What is its length, in cm?
questions.solution: Width $w$, length $3w+4$. Then $2(w+3w+4)=56$, so $8w+8=56$ and $w=6$. The length is $3\times6+4=22$.

questions.skill: Distance, perimeter and rate problems
questions.stem: One pipe fills a pool in 6 hours. A second pipe fills the same pool in 3 hours. Working together, how many hours do they take to fill it?
questions.solution: In $t$ hours the pipes fill $\frac{t}{6}+\frac{t}{3}$ of the pool. Set it equal to 1: $\frac{t}{6}+\frac{2t}{6}=1$, so $\frac{t}{2}=1$ and $t=2$.

questions.skill: Distance, perimeter and rate problems
questions.stem: Kim bikes to a lake at 12 miles per hour and comes back the same way at 4 miles per hour. The whole trip takes 2 hours. How many miles is it to the lake?
questions.solution: Let the distance be $d$ miles. Time out is $\frac{d}{12}$ and time back is $\frac{d}{4}$. So $\frac{d}{12}+\frac{d}{4}=2$. Multiply by 12: $d+3d=24$, so $d=6$.

questions.skill: Equations with no solution or with every number as a solution
questions.stem: For which number $k$ is every number a solution of $5x+k=3x+2(x+4)$?
questions.solution: The right side is $3x+2x+8=5x+8$. The two sides match for every $x$ when $k=8$.

questions.skill: Equations with no solution or with every number as a solution
questions.stem: For which value of $a$ does the equation $2(x+1)=ax+5$ have no solution?
questions.solution: The left side is $2x+2$. If $a=2$ the equation is $2x+2=2x+5$, which is never true. For any other $a$ there is exactly one solution.

questions.skill: Equations with no solution or with every number as a solution
questions.stem: Which of these equations has no solution?
questions.solution: In $3x+7=3x-7$, subtracting $3x$ gives $7=-7$, never true. The second has solution $x=0$, the third $x=1$, and the last is true for every $x$.

questions.skill: Use an equation to find another value
questions.stem: The equation $5x-k=3x+10$ has the solution $x=6$. What is $k$?

questions.skill: Use an equation to find another value
questions.stem: If $2(x-3)=3(x-5)$, what is the value of $x+1$?
questions.solution: Multiply out: $2x-6=3x-15$. So $9=x$. Then $x+1=10$.

questions.skill: Use an equation to find another value
questions.stem: If $4x+2=3x+9$, what is the value of $8x+4$?

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression with several variables
questions.stem: Find the value of $2a+3b$ when $a=4$ and $b=5$.
questions.solution: Replace $a$ with 4 and $b$ with 5: $2\times4+3\times5=8+15=23$.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression with several variables
questions.stem: If $x=3$ and $y=2$, what is the value of $xy+x$?
questions.solution: $xy$ means $3\times2=6$. Then $6+x=6+3=9$.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression with several variables
questions.stem: A pet shop has $c$ cats and $d$ dogs. The total number of legs is $4c+4d$. How many legs are there when $c=6$ and $d=3$?

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression with several variables
questions.stem: Find the value of $p^2-q$ when $p=5$ and $q=3$.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression with several variables
questions.stem: When $m=4$ and $n=1$, what is the value of $3m-5n$?

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression with several variables
questions.stem: Find the value of $a-bc$ when $a=10$, $b=2$ and $c=3$.
questions.solution: First $bc=2\times3=6$. Then $10-6=4$.

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression with several variables
questions.stem: Find the value of $\frac{x}{y}+y$ when $x=6$ and $y=3$.

questions.skill: Combine like terms with several variables
questions.stem: Which expression is equal to $3a+2b+4a$?
questions.solution: Only the $a$ terms combine: $3a+4a=7a$. The $2b$ stays. The answer is $7a+2b$.

questions.skill: Combine like terms with several variables
questions.stem: Simplify $5x+3y-2x+y$.
questions.solution: The $x$ terms give $5x-2x=3x$. The $y$ terms give $3y+y=4y$ (remember $y$ means $1y$). The result is $3x+4y$.

questions.skill: Combine like terms with several variables
questions.stem: Simplify $8a+3b-5a-3b$. The result is $ka$ for a number $k$. What is $k$?
questions.solution: The $b$ terms cancel: $3b-3b=0$. The $a$ terms give $8a-5a=3a$, so $k=3$.

questions.skill: Combine like terms with several variables
questions.stem: Which expression is equal to $4xy+xy$?
questions.solution: $4xy$ and $xy$ are like terms. $4$ of something plus $1$ of it is $5$ of it: $5xy$.

questions.skill: Combine like terms with several variables
questions.stem: Simplify $6m-2n-m-3n$.
questions.solution: $6m-m=5m$ and $-2n-3n=-5n$. So the result is $5m-5n$.

questions.skill: Combine like terms with several variables
questions.stem: Maya buys 3 pens and 2 notebooks. Leo buys 4 pens and 1 notebook. A pen costs $p$ dollars and a notebook costs $n$ dollars. Together they pay $ap+bn$ dollars. What is $a+b$?
questions.solution: Pens: $3p+4p=7p$. Notebooks: $2n+n=3n$. Together $7p+3n$, so $a=7$, $b=3$ and $a+b=10$.

questions.skill: Expand with the distributive property
questions.stem: Which expression is equal to $2(x+y)$?
questions.solution: The 2 multiplies both terms: $2\times x+2\times y=2x+2y$.

questions.skill: Expand with the distributive property
questions.stem: Which expression is equal to $3(a-b)$?
questions.solution: Multiply both $a$ and $b$ by 3, keeping the minus sign: $3a-3b$.

questions.skill: Expand with the distributive property
questions.stem: Expand $5(x+2y)$ and write it as $5x+ky$. What is $k$?

questions.skill: Expand with the distributive property
questions.stem: Expand $3(2a+b)$. What is the number multiplying $a$ in the result?
questions.solution: $3(2a+b)=6a+3b$. The number multiplying $a$ is 6.

questions.skill: Solve a formula for one variable: one step
questions.stem: Solve $a+b=c$ for $a$.
questions.solution: Subtract $b$ from both sides: $a=c-b$.

questions.skill: Solve a formula for one variable: one step
questions.stem: Solve $x-y=7$ for $x$.
questions.solution: Add $y$ to both sides: $x=7+y$.

questions.skill: Solve a formula for one variable: one step
questions.stem: Solve $p=3q$ for $q$.
questions.solution: $q$ is multiplied by 3, so divide both sides by 3: $q=\frac{p}{3}$.

questions.skill: Solve a formula for one variable: one step
questions.stem: Solve $P=a+b+c$ for $c$.
questions.solution: Subtract $a$ and $b$ from both sides: $c=P-a-b$.

questions.skill: Solve a formula for one variable: one step
questions.stem: Solve $s=2t+u$ for $u$.
questions.solution: Subtract $2t$ from both sides: $u=s-2t$.

questions.skill: Solve a formula for one variable: one step
questions.stem: Solve $d=rt$ for $r$.
questions.solution: $r$ is multiplied by $t$, so divide both sides by $t$: $r=\frac{d}{t}$.

questions.skill: Solve a formula for one variable: one step
questions.stem: Solve $x=y-5z$ for $y$.
questions.solution: Add $5z$ to both sides: $y=x+5z$.

questions.skill: Use a formula to find an unknown value
questions.stem: The area of a rectangle is $A=lw$, where $l$ is the length and $w$ is the width. A rectangle has area 36 and length 9. What is its width?

questions.skill: Use a formula to find an unknown value
questions.stem: The perimeter of a rectangle is $P=2l+2w$. A rectangle has perimeter 20 and length 7. What is its width?

questions.skill: Use a formula to find an unknown value
questions.stem: The cost $C$ of $n$ notebooks at $p$ dollars each is $C=np$. Nine notebooks cost 45 dollars. What is $p$, in dollars?

questions.skill: Use a formula to find an unknown value
questions.stem: A train travels 240 miles at a steady speed in 4 hours. Use $d=rt$ to find its speed $r$ in miles per hour.

questions.skill: Use a formula to find an unknown value
questions.stem: Three numbers satisfy $a+b+c=30$. If $a=8$ and $b=13$, what is $c$?

questions.skill: Write an expression with several variables
questions.stem: Adult tickets cost $a$ dollars each and child tickets cost $c$ dollars each. Which expression is the cost, in dollars, of 2 adult tickets and 3 child tickets?
questions.solution: 2 adult tickets cost $2a$ and 3 child tickets cost $3c$. Together: $2a+3c$.

questions.skill: Write an expression with several variables
questions.stem: A box holds $n$ pencils. Sam has $b$ full boxes and $p$ extra pencils. Which expression gives the number of pencils Sam has?
questions.solution: Each of the $b$ boxes holds $n$ pencils, so the boxes hold $bn$. Add the $p$ extra: $bn+p$.

solve.work: b boxes of n is bn, plus p: bn+p

questions.skill: Evaluate an expression with several variables
questions.stem: Ana is $a$ years old and her brother is $b$ years old. How many years older is Ana than her brother when $a=12$ and $b=7$?
questions.solution: The difference is $a-b=12-7=5$ years.
